**Side goal `website-overhaul`, stage 4 (Syntax) is in progress: "Start here", the Basics pages, the "Values and types" pages and the six Operators pages are written.**

`tools/nv/cmd/site.ts` `syntaxProblems` is the `syntax` part, tested in `tools/nv/test/site.test.ts`. Every Syntax page except `syntax/index.mdx` needs a non-empty `covers:`, a `<Snippet>` and a `## Do and don't` list.

On disk: `website/src/content/docs/syntax/start-here.mdx`, `syntax/basics/*.mdx`, `syntax/values/*.mdx` and `syntax/operators/{arithmetic,comparison,null-coalescing,string-operators,pipeline,precedence}.mdx`. Sidebar entries are in `website/astro.config.ts`, stamps in `website/site.lock.json` (`bun nv site --stamp <page>...`). A front-matter value with `: ` in it must be quoted, or `covers:` reads as missing.

`site structure`, `stale` and `reference` pass. `site syntax` reports 105 uncovered features. Ids already assigned to later pages: `lang:types/callable-classes-object-shapes`, `lang:types/properties-and-constants`, `lang:expressions/object-literals`, `Comparable`, `Stringable`, `Parses` and `PropertyObserver` go to Classes. `lang:types/parameters`, `lang:types/void-never-self-static`, `lang:expressions/calls` and `lang:expressions/closures-fn` go to Functions. `lang:expressions/match` goes to Control flow. `lang:expressions/is-new-clone-throw-print-exit-isset-empty` goes to Classes (it covers `new` and `clone`). `lang:expressions/arrays-in-expressions` (destructuring) goes on `syntax/values/arrays.mdx`. The Throwable tree goes to Errors. `snippets` and `prose` fail only on pages that stages 5 and 6 rewrite.
